Name: Scope 1 Diesel Emissions (tCO2e)
Expression: DIVIDE(SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Generator_Diesel_Litres]) * 2.68, 1000, 0)

Name: Scope 2 Grid Electricity Emissions (tCO2e)
Expression: DIVIDE(SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Grid_Electricity_kWh]) * 0.93, 1000, 0)

Name: Total Scope 1 & 2 Emissions (tCO2e)
Expression: [Scope 1 Diesel Emissions (tCO2e)] + [Scope 2 Grid Electricity Emissions (tCO2e)]

Name: Solar Carbon Avoided (tCO2e)
Expression: DIVIDE(SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Solar_Generated_kWh]) * 0.93, 1000, 0)

Name: Renewable Energy Mix %
Expression:
VAR TotalDemand = SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Total_Electricity_Demand_kWh])
VAR SolarKwh = SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Solar_Generated_kWh])
RETURN
DIVIDE(SolarKwh, TotalDemand, 0)

Name: Total Retail Area (SqM)
Expression: SUM(Dim_Stores[Retail_GLA_SqM])

Name: Energy Intensity (kWh / SqM)
Expression:
VAR TotalEnergy = SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Total_Electricity_Demand_kWh])
VAR TotalGLA = [Total Retail Area (SqM)]
RETURN
DIVIDE(TotalEnergy, TotalGLA, 0)

Name: Carbon Intensity (kgCO2e / SqM)
Expression:
VAR TotalKgCO2e = ([Total Scope 1 & 2 Emissions (tCO2e)] * 1000)
VAR TotalGLA = [Total Retail Area (SqM)]
RETURN
DIVIDE(TotalKgCO2e, TotalGLA, 0)

Name: Water Intensity (kL / SqM)
Expression:
VAR TotalWater = SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Municipal_Water_kL])
VAR TotalGLA = [Total Retail Area (SqM)]
RETURN
DIVIDE(TotalWater, TotalGLA, 0)

Name: Total Packaging Waste (Tonnes)
Expression: DIVIDE(SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Packaging_Waste_kg]), 1000, 0)

Name: Total Recycled Waste (Tonnes)
Expression: DIVIDE(SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Recycled_Packaging_kg]), 1000, 0)

Name: Packaging Recycling Diversion Rate %
Expression:
VAR Recycled = SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Recycled_Packaging_kg])
VAR TotalPkg = SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Packaging_Waste_kg])
RETURN
DIVIDE(Recycled, TotalPkg, 0)

Name: Hazardous Medical Waste (kg)
Expression: SUM(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Hazardous_Clinical_Waste_kg])

Name: Medical Waste Manifest Compliance Rate %
Expression:
VAR TotalClinicRecords = COUNTROWS(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly)
VAR CompliantManifests = 
    CALCULATE(
        COUNTROWS(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly),
        Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Clinical_Waste_Manifest_Status] = "Compliant - Manifest on File"
    )
RETURN
DIVIDE(CompliantManifests, TotalClinicRecords, 0)

Name: Total Store Reporting Months
Expression: COUNTROWS(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly)

Name: Audit Verified Months
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly),
    Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Assurance_Audit_Status] = "Verified - Audit Trail Clear"
)

Name: Assurance Audit Readiness %
Expression: DIVIDE([Audit Verified Months], [Total Store Reporting Months], 0)

Name: High Risk Audit Exceptions Count
Municipal Estimate Billing Share %
Expression:
VAR EstimatedRecords = 
    CALCULATE(
        COUNTROWS(Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly),
        Fact_Store_ESG_Monthly[Municipal_Billing_Type] = "Municipal Estimate"
    )
RETURN
DIVIDE(EstimatedRecords, [Total Store Reporting Months], 0)

Name: Total Active Suppliers
Expression: COUNTROWS(Dim_Suppliers_ESG)

Name: Total Sourcing Spend (ZAR Millions)
Expression: SUM(Dim_Suppliers_ESG[Annual_Spend_ZAR_Millions])

Name: Supplier CoC Sign-Off Rate %
Expression:
VAR SignedCount = 
    CALCULATE(
        COUNTROWS(Dim_Suppliers_ESG),
        Dim_Suppliers_ESG[Code_of_Conduct_Status] = "Executed & Active"
    )
RETURN
DIVIDE(SignedCount, [Total Active Suppliers], 0)

Name: Weighted Supplier ESG Score
Expression:
VAR TotalSpend = [Total Sourcing Spend (ZAR Millions)]
VAR WeightedPoints = 
    SUMX(
        Dim_Suppliers_ESG,
        Dim_Suppliers_ESG[ESG_Audit_Score] * Dim_Suppliers_ESG[Annual_Spend_ZAR_Millions]
    )
RETURN
DIVIDE(WeightedPoints, TotalSpend, 0)

Name: High Risk Spend Exposure (ZAR Millions)
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Sourcing Spend (ZAR Millions)],
    Dim_Suppliers_ESG[ESG_Risk_Rating] = "High Risk - Corrective Action Plan Required"
)

Name: High Risk Spend Exposure %
Expression: DIVIDE([High Risk Spend Exposure (ZAR Millions)], [Total Sourcing Spend (ZAR Millions)], 0)

Name: Status Color - Audit Readiness
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Assurance Audit Readiness %] >= 0.90, "#10B981",
    [Assurance Audit Readiness %] >= 0.80, "#F59E0B",
    "#EF4444"
)

Name: Status Color - Supplier Risk
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [High Risk Spend Exposure %] <= 0.10, "#10B981",
    [High Risk Spend Exposure %] <= 0.20, "#F59E0B",
    "#EF4444"
)
